body:
Current requirements:
| # | Description | Level | #v5.0.be |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **8.1.3** | Verify that authorization documentation defines controls that incorporate changes to a consumer's environmental and contextual attributes (such as time of day, location, IP address, or device) to make security decisions, including those pertaining to authentication and authorization. These changes must be detected both when the consumer tries to start a new session or during an existing session. | 3 | v5.0.be-1.4.6 |
| **8.2.4** | Verify that adaptive security controls related to authentication and authorization decisions based on a consumer's environmental and contextual attributes (such as time of day, location, IP address, or device) are implemented as defined in authorization documentation. | 3 | v5.0.be-4.1.8 |

From 8.1.3 "These changes must be detected both when the consumer tries to start a new session or during an existing session." - this seems like it should be part of implementation requirement (8.2.4)

But...

8.1.3 describes "documentation defines controls that incorporate changes" for "extra parameters"

and

8.2.4 descibes that authentication and authorization decisions must take "extra parameters" into account

So I would say that those are not well aligned.

comments.body:
Good eye and  I agree. Perhaps:

| # | Description | Level | #v5.0.be |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **8.1.3** | Verify that authorization documentation defines controls that incorporates consumer's environmental and contextual attributes (such as time of day, location, IP address, or device) to make security decisions, including those pertaining to authentication and authorization. | 3 | v5.0.be-1.4.6 |
| **8.2.4** | Verify that adaptive security controls related to authentication and authorization decisions based on a consumer's environmental and contextual attributes (such as time of day, location, IP address, or device) are implemented as defined in authorization documentation.  These changes must be detected both when the consumer tries to start a new session or during an existing session. | 3 | v5.0.be-4.1.8 |

I think the wording is a little hard to understand anyway.

Based on Jim's suggestion, can I suggest

| # | Description | Level | #v5.0.be |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **8.1.3** | Verify that authorization documentation defines a consumer's environmental and contextual attributes (such as time of day, location, IP address, or device) should be used in the application to make security decisions, including those pertaining to authentication and authorization. | 3 | v5.0.be-1.4.6 |
| **8.2.4** | Verify that adaptive security controls based on a consumer's environmental and contextual attributes (such as time of day, location, IP address, or device) are implemented  for authentication and authorization decisions, as defined in the application's documentation.  These controls must be applied when the consumer tries to start a new session and also during an existing session. | 3 | v5.0.be-4.1.8 |

Started to make PR, but... tiny change for 8.1.3?
> Verify that authorization documentation defines a consumer's environmental and contextual attributes (such as time of day, location, IP address, or device) ~~should~~ **that must** be used in the application to make security decisions, including those pertaining to authentication and authorization.

> Started to make PR, but... tiny change for 8.1.3?
> 
> > Verify that authorization documentation defines a consumer's environmental and contextual attributes (such as time of day, location, IP address, or device) ~should~ **that must** be used in the application to make security decisions, including those pertaining to authentication and authorization.

Yeah sure
